title: Dialog with a scrolling body
summary: Header and footer keep their size while the middle scrolls, using min-height: 0 on the flexible part.
explanation: The dialog is a flex column with a fixed height. The header and footer keep their content height, and the body gets flex: 1 to take whatever is left.

The body also needs min-height: 0. Flex items default to min-height: auto, so the body would grow to fit all its text and push the footer out of view. min-height: 0 lets it shrink, and overflow-y: auto then scrolls it.
tryThis: Remove min-height: 0 from .body: the footer slides below the frame and the dialog stops scrolling.
Remove flex: 1 from .body: the body stops filling the space and the footer rises up beneath the header.
Add more paragraphs to .body and watch only the middle scroll.
